svg.title: Bitmap and vector graphics
svg.desc: The same circle enlarged two ways. On the left, a bitmap (raster) image is made of pixels: when it is enlarged, the square pixels show and the edge looks jagged. On the right, a vector image is stored as shapes described by mathematics: when it is enlarged, the edge stays smooth. Bitmaps suit photographs; vectors suit logos, diagrams and drawings.
svg.text: Vector: made of shapes and maths
red squares: points that define the curve
